neighbours.label: removing chores or overhead: fewer/no tasks to do, a simpler system, or avoiding complex requirements
fire: Switching to online billing means simpler accounts and fewer letters to send.
With paper plates at the picnic, there are no dishes to wash and no cups to dry.
Buying a prefabricated shed avoids the complex planning approvals needed for an extension.
The new payroll tool means fewer spreadsheets to update and simpler tax returns.
On a camping trip with a cooler, there are no ovens to clean and no pans to scour.
Renting the equipment avoids the complex maintenance contracts required for ownership.
A single shared calendar means fewer emails to answer and simpler scheduling.
With disposable nappies, there are no cloths to boil and no buckets to rinse.
quiet: Switching to online billing means faster payments and happier customers.
With paper plates at the picnic, everyone could sit on the grass and eat.
Buying a prefabricated shed gives you a dry place to keep the bikes.
The new payroll tool gives managers the ability to see every payment.
On a camping trip with a cooler, the drinks stay cold for days.
Renting the equipment gives the crew more capacity on busy weekends.
A single shared calendar shows the whole team's holidays at a glance.
With disposable nappies, the baby bag is light enough to carry easily.

notes: Card: no single token; peaks ' complex' (avoiding complex studies), 'managing' (burden of managing keys), 'storing', 'need for', 'simpler', 'sterilize' (no bottles to sterilize). + pole: ability/capacity at one's disposal. Probe: 'simpler bookkeeping and fewer forms to file' 0.51 (peak ' fewer'), 'no plates to scrub and no towels to dry' 0.36, 'avoids the complex permits required' 0.30, 'burden of patching' 0.17. Ability/capacity/disposal controls 0.01-0.03. Fire items reuse the three strong frames (fewer X to do, no X to do, avoids the complex Y). Near misses state a benefit without removing a chore.
